welcome: Welcome to Sema. Choose a film with the arrows, then press Select.
onboarding: Choose Essential for key actions, Standard for story and context, or Rich for more visual detail where dialogue allows. Press Select during the film to change your level or revisit a moment. Earlier moment describes an older scene without rewinding. Using VoiceView? Turn spoken guidance off to avoid hearing controls twice.
choose_level: Choose a description level, then select Play.
ready: Ready. You can change the description level first, if you like.
resume_offer: You stopped partway through this film. You can resume, or start over.
package_changed: This film's description was updated since you last watched, so it starts from the beginning.
paused_return: Paused. Press Back again to leave the film.
recovery_more: Description complete. Another missed description is waiting.
no_moment: No visual moment is available yet. Play a little further, then try again.
film_ended_pending: The film has ended. A missed description is waiting.
buffering: Playback paused while the film loads.
level_fixed: In this session, the description level is fixed at Standard.
prompts_off: Spoken guidance off. Use VoiceView to hear the controls.
error_package: This film's description package did not pass its checks, so it cannot play.
help: Press Select to pause. Choose a description level, revisit the latest moment, or hear an earlier one. Resume continues where you paused. Back returns to the catalog. Fast-forward and rewind move five seconds.
label_level_essential_selected: Essential. Key story moments. Current level.
label_level_standard_selected: Standard. Story and context. Current level.
label_level_rich_selected: Rich. More visual detail. Current level.
film_tears_of_steel: Tears of Steel. The Bridge. A seventy-two second science fiction excerpt.
film_sintel_dragon: Sintel. The Rooftop. A seventy-two second excerpt. A young woman explores a sunlit city.
film_red_envelope_fixture: The red envelope. Fifteen second engineering test clip.
start_over_confirm: Press Select again to start over from the beginning.
label_start_over_confirm: Press Select again to start over.
no_earlier: There is no earlier moment to revisit yet.
error_baseline: The fixed Standard comparison soundtrack is not available for this film.
